title: How to cancel Dialpad in 2026: Steps, refunds, and what to do first
summary: How to cancel a Dialpad account or free trial, when you can do it yourself versus contact support, Dialpad's no-refund policy, and why you should port your number before you cancel.
body_markdown:
People tell us they switch away from Dialpad because of rising costs, confusing app navigation, call quality issues, and difficulty reaching support. Sound familiar? If you’re ready to cancel Dialpad, here’s how:


If you are on a month-to-month plan with 10 licenses or fewer, you can cancel from Billing Summary in your Dialpad Admin Settings. If you are on an annual plan or have more than 10 licenses, you have to contact Dialpad’s Customer Success team. If you’re still on a free trial, you can cancel from the same Billing Summary page. Two things to know before you start: Dialpad doesn’t issue refunds or prorated credits once you cancel, and you should port your phone number out before canceling, not after, or you risk losing it.


Keep reading for the full breakdown of how to cancel Dialpad.


##


Before you cancel, port your number out


If you plan to keep your phone number, start the port-out process before you cancel. Porting is a carrier-to-carrier transfer that requires the account to still be active.


1. Pick your new provider and start the port request with them, not with Dialpad.
2. Gather the necessary information: your port-out PIN from Dialpad, your account number, the exact billing information Dialpad has on file, and a recent bill.
3. Keep your Dialpad service active and paid until the port completes. Ports typically take 1-2 weeks.
4. Confirm the number is live with the new provider.
5. Only then cancel your Dialpad account.


For the step-by-step process, including how to generate your port-out PIN, follow our guide to[porting your numbers out of Dialpad](https://support.quo.com/getting-started/porting/dialpad) .


##


How to cancel a Dialpad free trial or month-to-month account


If you are on a free trial, or on a[month-to-month Dialpad plan](https://www.quo.com/blog/dialpad-pricing/) with 10 licenses or fewer:


1. Sign in to Dialpad as an admin.


2. Open Admin Settings.


3. Go to Billing, then Billing Summary.


4. Choose the option to cancel subscription and follow the prompts.


5. Save or screenshot the confirmation.


**Do two things before you click through** . First, remove any licenses you are not using, because Dialpad does not refund unused licenses and will not credit them retroactively. Second, export anything you need to keep, including call recordings, transcripts, contacts, and message history.


**Pro tip:** Canceling a free trial before it converts is the best way to avoid the first charge. Dialpad only has a 3-day refund window within the transaction date.


##


How to cancel an annual plan or an account with more than 10 licenses


On an annual plan, or managing more than 10 licenses, cancellation goes through Dialpad’s Customer Success team rather than a button in the app. That means contacting them by email at[\[email protected\]](https://www.quo.com/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#492a3c3a3d26242c3b3a3c2a2a2c3a3a3d2c2824092d20282539282d672a2624) .


Ask for three things explicitly:


- Written confirmation that the account is canceled
- The effective termination date
- Confirmation that no further charges will be processed.


Note your renewal date before you start, because an annual term that renews while you are still in the conversation is a common way people end up paying for another year.


##


What you lose when you cancel


Cancellation means closing the account, not pausing it, so a few things go away on your termination date:


- **Unused texting and** **international calling credits** **expire** . Spend them or lose them.
- **Your number is released unless you ported it out first** . Start the porting process before cancelling if you want to keep your number.
- **Integrations stop syncing.** Anything connecting Dialpad to a CRM or help desk stops connecting when you cancel. Historical call logs already written into those systems usually stay put.


##


Alternatives to cancelling the account


If the problem is cost, not the product, you have options besides leaving:


- **Remove unused licenses.** Fastest real saving. Because Dialpad doesn’t refund seats, doing this before your next billing date is the only version that helps.
- **Downgrade the plan.** Pro to Standard cuts the per-user rate, but you lose integrations, international texting, and additional numbers. Reach out to[Dialpad’s Customer Care Team](https://dialpad.com/login?c=/contact-support) to downgrade.
- **Drop add-ons.** AI Scorecards, AI CSAT, and other AI-heavy add-on features can burn through budgets if you’re not using them.


Unfortunately, pausing isn’t really on the table. Dialpad doesn’t offer a self-serve pause. If you need a temporary stop, ask Dialpad support what’s actually available.

##


Dialpad cancellation and refund FAQs


**Can you cancel Dialpad yourself?**


Yes, you can cancel Dialpad yourself if you’re on a free trial or a month-to-month plan with 10 licenses or fewer. Cancel from Billing Summary in your Admin Settings. On an annual plan, or with more than 10 licenses, you have to go through Dialpad’s[Customer Success team](https://www.quo.com/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#a7c4d2d4d3c8cac2d5d4d2c4c4c2d4d4d3c2c6cae7c3cec6cbd7c6c389c4c8ca) .


**Does Dialpad give refunds?**


No, Dialpad doesn’t offer refunds, prorations, or transfers on cancellation, and unused calling credits expire on the termination date. The exception is a 3-day window: if you cancel within three days of the transaction date, on monthly or annual billing, a refund is processed.


**Can I cancel a Dialpad annual plan early?**


You can cancel, but you will not be refunded for the remaining months. Dialpad’s position is that annual plans are already discounted and therefore do not qualify for a mid-term refund. Your service continues to the end of the term you paid for.


**How do I cancel a Dialpad free trial before being charged?**


Cancel a free trial from Billing Summary in Admin Settings before it ends. Because Dialpad’s refund window is only three days from the transaction date, canceling during the trial is the cleanest way to avoid the first charge.


**Should I cancel Dialpad before or after porting my number?**


You should cancel after porting your number. Port your number to your new provider first and keep your Dialpad subscription active until the port completes. Porting usually takes 1-2 weeks. Canceling first releases the number and you may not be able to recover it.


**Do I need to cancel Dialpad Meetings separately?**


Yes, Dialpad has a separate[cancellation process for Meetings](https://help.dialpad.com/docs/cancel-a-meetings-account) accounts. If you use both Meetings and Dialpad Connect, confirm each one is canceled and get written confirmation for both.


**What happens to my call recordings and data after I cancel?**


Export them before you cancel. Recordings, transcripts, voicemail, contacts, and message history should be downloaded while the account is still active.
If you are in healthcare, confirm your data retention obligations first; see whether[Dialpad meets HIPAA requirements](https://www.quo.com/blog/is-dialpad-hipaa-compliant/)
